experiments.title: Minimum detectable effect and coverage of the 39-window evaluation harness
experiments.question: What is the smallest effect the frozen 39-window harness can actually see, is it vulnerable to single-item domination, and can coverage be widened cheaply without touching the freeze?
experiments.conclusion: MDE is not one number - it depends on the arm's shape. Measured 95% CI half-widths give MDE at 80% power: 0.24 for a surgical post-hoc arm (arm E), 0.69 for a decode ablation, 1.27 for a different adapter under the same decode, 1.37 for hotword biasing, 2.66 for us-vs-commercial, and ~2.94 single-seed (SD 1.05) rising to ~3.2 in composition. Arm E's -0.25 sits EXACTLY on its own threshold, not comfortably above it. WER is NOT vulnerable to single-item domination (18/39 windows for 50% of tokens, 12/39 for 50% of errors, LOO <=0.94 points). DS-WER v2 entities already separates 0.488 from 0.328 (+0.175 [0.093,0.258], MDE80 ~0.117) though its top 4 windows carry 51.5% of N. A 63-window extension exists at ZERO human cost (60 training-unseen meetings, 7 cities, 18,821 tokens, human references already in the public benchmark, outside the freeze and outside holdout, ~103 CPU-minutes per arm) but buys only 15% narrower CIs and is POORER in entities (8.9 vs 21.0 per 1,000 tokens). The blind spot is seeds, not windows, and more windows do not fix it.
experiments.decision: Do not treat excludes_zero as a sufficient gate for single-sign post-hoc arms: with 31 blocks the paired bootstrap excludes zero for ANY single-sign arm touching >=4 meetings regardless of effect size ((1-4/31)^31 = 0.014 < 0.025). Arm E touches 11, so its excludes_zero was guaranteed by construction - this does not invalidate arm E (the benchmark look supplies the magnitude independently) but it does retire the gate. Replacement gate is an open decision.
caveats: MDE figures are derived from ALREADY MEASURED CI half-widths on this freeze, not from a prospective power analysis; they describe what this harness has done, and assume a new arm resembles one of the listed shapes.

The freeze manifest declares 31 blocks while 32 (city, meeting) pairs exist: apr7_2026 appears in two cities and the bootstrap block key is meeting_id alone. This is CONSERVATIVE for CI width. Recorded, not changed.
Human-hours for building brand-new windows are NOT computable from this repo - no measured rate exists, only a design-time estimate of 5.5h per 100 windows.
Design reviewed by Codex at high effort (job 313f1f7e); its corrections on power-vs-significance, the support threshold and the section 4 decomposition were incorporated.
The 7 sealed temporal holdout windows were not touched. No GPU spend.

experiments.title: 2026 landscape scan: what attacks deletions and names in low-resource ASR
experiments.question: What techniques available in 2026 attack our two specific errors - silent speech omissions and surname/toponym substitutions - rather than general WER, and which fit the remaining GSoC runway?
experiments.conclusion: Ranked for the remaining runway: (1) cross-system ROVER fusion with Soniox and Scribe - the only item that BYPASSES 'the deletions live in the weights', since words absent from all our beams are present in their transcripts; 0 GPU, ~4-8 human-hours. (2) Roster-grounded constrained correction, RECOVER-style phonetic retrieval plus a Krikri-8B editor, working over a CLOSED list; literature reports 8-46% relative E-WER without overall WER regression. (3) NeMo canary-1b-v2 with GPU-PB/TurboBias ACOUSTIC-level word boosting (not prompt-level) - the mechanism that explains why our hotword arm paid +133 deletions; FLEURS el 9.21 verified on the model card, zero-shot measurement only within 5 days. Four assumption-breaking findings: VoxKrikri (ILSP, arXiv:2509.15667) is trained ON HParl and beats whisper-large-v3 13.01 vs 16.99 in the same table, so the corpus we deprioritised as 'unusable targets' worked for someone else; NO reference-free detector for missing speech spans exists in 2026 (the entire hallucination-detection literature targets EXTRA text, and Whisper-CD's numbers come from degenerate baselines at WER 208 and 520, which do not transfer to our 0.1377); LLM-based generative error correction is documented to DEGRADE named entities and to worsen baselines in low-error regimes, an independent confirmation of our own arm D failure; and NeMo has no official LoRA recipe for Canary/Parakeet, only full fine-tuning at 20-80 A100-hours per 100h.
experiments.decision: Keep fusion first in the runway - the landscape independently confirms the ordering already chosen. Do not attempt a backbone swap or an LLM rewriter within this cycle. Any LLM in the fusion arm must SELECT among candidates, never rewrite.
caveats: Literature scan via grok-research with citations, not reproduction: no number in this report was measured by us, and none has been reproduced on our data.
VoxKrikri carries a licence discrepancy - Apache-2.0 on HuggingFace, Llama 3.1 Community in the paper - which must be resolved before any use.
Published Greek WER figures (FLEURS, Common Voice) are read-speech benchmarks and do not transfer to long-form council audio; they rank candidates, they do not predict our numbers.
This scan does NOT reopen exp-2026-08-14-hparl-probe: the CLARIN 1602 licence question that put it out of scope is untouched by it.

experiments.title: Does the consensus vote win by deleting, and does the corrected adapter vote better
experiments.question: Does cross-system consensus fusion lower WER at the cost of a higher deletion rate, and does swapping the broken third voter for artifact-adapter-fixed change the result?
experiments.conclusion: No on the first, not measurably on the second. The vote CUTS deletions rather than buying WER with them: del_rate 0.0247 against Scribe's 0.0380 (-0.0133 [-0.0159,-0.0108], CI excludes zero) and against our own adapter's 0.0459, i.e. nearly half. It pays +0.0069 [+0.0037,+0.0104] in insertions, a strongly favourable trade, and total WER falls -0.0121 [-0.0158,-0.0084]. Single-item domination check passes (dropping the most influential window moves the deletion delta only -0.01331 -> -0.01289). The mechanism is Soniox: it deletes 0.0142, three times less than Scribe and three times less than us, paying with the table's highest insertion rate 0.0750 - it is not the best system, it is the system that does not go silent. This is the first thing in this project that reaches the deletions: the serving-stack ladder showed they live in the weights and no decode-time technique touches them because the words are absent from all 8 hypotheses - OUR 8 hypotheses. They are not absent from Soniox. On the second question, swapping oc-minipc-finetune for oc-runpod-fixed-2026-08-10 in a paired design gives WER -0.00128 [-0.00327,+0.00082], CI includes zero, the overwhelming majority of 247 windows tied. Two indications point the same way but are not results: the corrected adapter is picked more often by the vote (25 vs 16 windows) and it raises the trio oracle ceiling (0.1099 -> 0.1064). Incidentally, artifact-adapter-fixed is the SECOND-BEST single system on this benchmark at 0.1386, behind only Scribe 0.1322 and ahead of Soniox, Gladia, whisper-large-v3 and gpt-4o-transcribe.
experiments.decision: Use the corrected adapter as the third voter - there is no reason not to - but claim no gain from the swap. Fusion is the live route to the deletion problem and outranks further single-model training for the remaining runway. Any deployment decision is a cost decision for OpenCouncil (three ASR bills instead of one), not a WER decision.
caveats: CORRECTED 2026-08-16 AFTER FIRST PUBLICATION: the first run scored 253 windows, which contained 6 of the 7 SEALED temporal holdout windows of eval-freeze-2026-08 - the freeze had drawn them from this same benchmark run. Caught while resolving wayfinder #17. They were removed and every number recomputed on 247 windows / 144 meetings. No conclusion changed (deletion delta -0.0136 -> -0.0133, CI still excludes zero). exp_fusion_deletions.py now filters the seal explicitly so it cannot recur.

The trio was NOT re-selected here; it is inherited from exp-2026-08-02-asr-fusion where it was chosen by trying every subset against these same references - selection on the test set. The split-half check there shows the PROCEDURE generalises, not the specific trio.

Different sample from exp-2026-08-02-asr-fusion: that ran on 2026-06-10-oc-benchmark (250 windows), this on the 2026-08-10 report (247 windows: 253 common to all 9 providers minus the 6 sealed holdout). Absolute numbers are not directly comparable across the two reports.
Agreement-with-OpenCouncil, not fidelity-to-audio. 'The vote recovers deletions' means it recovers words present in OUR reference text.
Training contamination does not produce the effect: on the 99 training-disjoint windows the vote's gain is LARGER than on the contaminated ones.

Scored with eval/controlled_eval/scoring.py, not the benchmark app's scorer (which trims window-boundary words), so these numbers are comparable to exp-2026-08-02-asr-fusion and NOT to the published leaderboard.
The second-best-single-system observation was not the question and was not preregistered; it is an observation.
247 two-minute windows in 10 cities. Enough to show the effect is not city-specific, not enough to describe Greek council audio in general.

experiments.title: pyannoteAI precision-2 with transcription: fourth voter, omission detector, word-level speaker
experiments.question: Does pyannoteAI precision-2 with transcription:true and exclusive:true give a useful fourth ASR voter, a lower deletion rate by virtue of a monotonic transducer, and a reference-free detector for missing speech?
experiments.conclusion: One of three. (1) Parakeet-TDT-0.6b-v3 is NOT usable for Greek council audio: WER 0.3567 against the corrected adapter's 0.1386, zero wins in 247 windows (+0.2181), and 78% of its error is substitutions - it does not lose speech, it does not know Greek. Published FLEURS/Common Voice figures do not transfer, as preregistered. (2) As a fourth voter it adds nothing: -0.0014 WER and -0.0009 del_rate, both CIs include zero, and the four-way oracle is IDENTICAL to the three-way oracle to four decimals - it is the best system in no window at all. THE MONOTONICITY HYPOTHESIS IS DISPROVEN: its deletion rate is 0.0453, 3.2x Soniox's 0.0142 and statistically indistinguishable from our own autoregressive adapter's 0.0459. Being a transducer did not buy a lower deletion rate. (3) The omission detector WORKS: intervals where exclusiveDiarization asserts speech while our transcript has no words hit real deletions at precision 0.320 against a fair random-interval null of 0.094 (+0.226 [+0.144,+0.324], CI excludes zero), recall 0.101. A precision alarm, not a net - and it is the only publishable piece here, since no reference-free detector for missing speech spans exists in the 2026 literature. Cost $1.88-$3.13 for 250 jobs / 10.16 audio hours, zero failures, zero GPU. | ROUND 2 (faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo as the STT, same 247 windows, $1.88-3.13, billing confirmed per audio-hour not compute-time): Whisper-turbo alone WER 0.1666 / del 0.0423 - usable Greek, unlike Parakeet's 0.3567, but not competitive: worse than plain large-v3 (+0.0207) and than our adapter (+0.0281), both CIs exclude zero. As a FOURTH VOTER IT WON, against the agent's own preregistered null: -0.00448 WER [-0.00799,-0.00160], CI excludes zero - but the gain is in INSERTIONS (0.0443 -> 0.0385), not deletions (-0.00004, CI includes zero), and the voter is correlated with our backbone by construction. THE SPEAKER-INFORMATION QUESTION, which was the user's actual goal: NO overall, YES inside overlap. Per-turn selection beats per-window (-0.0036, CI excludes zero) but a PLACEBO of equally many cuts at non-speaker boundaries beats it MORE (-0.0056); turn minus placebo = +0.0020 [+0.0004,+0.0037], i.e. speaker cuts are WORSE - what wins is locality, not speaker identity. Without that control the finding would have been reported as 'speaker information helps by 0.36 points' and would have been false. Restricted to the 823 cells with DETECTED OVERLAP (24,079 tokens) the sign REVERSES: turn minus placebo = -0.00558 [-0.00888,-0.00228], CI excludes zero, 166 wins / 56 ties / 96 losses. Using the transcript to separate speakers works, and only where they talk over each other. OMISSION DETECTOR, prediction DISPROVEN: the regular diarization finds LESS missing speech than exclusive (108 flags, R=0.107 vs 125, R=0.134), for a structural reason - in an interval {A,B} a single word from A blocks the flag even if all of B's turn was lost, so a 'no words of ours here' rule cannot see the loss of one speaker inside simultaneous speech. A per-speaker density rule is needed and was deliberately NOT tried, since it would be threshold selection after the numbers. ERROR LOCALISATION, the most directly actionable result: 5.1% of tokens near a speaker handover carry 11.4% of reference-side errors, and the 2.45% inside overlap carry 7.3% (del 0.0599 vs 0.0238, +0.0361 [+0.0193,+0.0535]) - identifiable today without a reference, and a targeting signal for exp-2026-08-13-targeted-deletion-training.
experiments.decision: Do not add Parakeet as a voter and do not pursue faster-whisper-turbo through this API as an ASR source. Keep exclusiveDiarization as an omission-detection signal: it is the one place where an acoustic model supplies evidence our own hypotheses cannot. The CTC/transducer-monotonicity argument for a Whisper CTC head is weakened by this result and must not be quoted as motivation without acknowledging it. ROUND 2: do not adopt Whisper-turbo as a production voter - it is correlated with our backbone and its win is in insertions only. Speaker-aware selection INSIDE detected overlap was the standing next step here; it was CARRIED OUT and is now closed by exp-2026-08-16-overlap-speaker-arms - do not re-open it as an instruction. Any future claim that 'speaker information helps selection' must carry the placebo control, which reversed the naive reading. 2026-08-16: the inside-overlap speaker advantage was carried onto W by exp-2026-08-16-overlap-speaker-arms and NOT demonstrated there (turn minus placebo +0.00094, CI [-0.00600,+0.00833], which still contains this experiment's -0.00558). Do not quote the -0.00558 as if it transferred, and do not quote the null as if transfer were refuted.
caveats: SEAL BREACH FOUND AND CONTAINED: 6 of the 7 sealed temporal holdout windows of eval-freeze-2026-08 sit inside the 253-window benchmark report. They were excluded here (n=247) and every comparison recomputed on the same 247. The same breach had already affected exp-2026-08-16-fusion-deletions, which was corrected in the same change.

ROUND 2's fourth-voter win contradicts the agent's own preregistered expectation of a null. It is reported as measured, with the constraint that the gain is insertion-side only and the voter is not independent of our backbone.

The omission detector's per-speaker density rule was not tried here on purpose (choosing that threshold after seeing the numbers would be selection on the result). It was preregistered and measured on 2026-08-16 by exp-2026-08-16-overlap-speaker-arms, which found the obvious density form provably unable to fire on the case it was for, replaced it with a missing-speaker count, and measured recall 0.1075 -> 0.2020 at 2.27x the alerts.

Two Codex reviews ran before any number was seen. The first introduced the placebo control that reversed the headline. The second found a speaker-scan bug (set of labels instead of counts) and a handover definition that MISSED handovers via overlap ({A}->{A,B}->{B}) - precisely the transitions the experiment was about. Locked with 15 tests.

The omission detector's ground truth is agreement-with-OpenCouncil, not a human listening to the audio, so precision 0.320 is a LOWER BOUND: a span our reference also omits counts as a false positive here. exp-2026-08-16-gold-set later WITHDREW the 'lower bound' label as unproven, and exp-2026-08-16-overlap-speaker-arms did not re-establish it (4 flags in 27 gold cells, below its own preregistered floor for claiming anything).

Two measurement errors were caught by Codex review (high effort) BEFORE any number was seen: the random null was unfair (random intervals could land in silence) and the time interpolation snapped extreme deletion runs onto adjacent recognised speech. Both fixed and declared on the issue before analysis.

pyannoteAI publishes no balance endpoint; the cost is a projection from GET /v2/jobs quantity and the public price (EUR 0.112/h diarization, EUR 0.168/h STT orchestration), and the page does not state whether the two are additive, so both scenarios are carried.

Only the default STT (Parakeet-TDT) was measured. faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo is offered by the same endpoint and was NOT tested; it would not be an independent voter anyway, being the same family as our own model.
247 two-minute windows, 10 cities, agreement-with-OpenCouncil references.

experiments.title: Glossary provenance, leakage extent, and distillation to a usable term list
experiments.question: Can the 2026-06-20 glossary's provenance be proven, how far does its leakage reach into the benchmark, and which of its terms deserve a place beside the frozen roster and per-city lists?
experiments.conclusion: Provenance PROVEN: scripts/glossary_manifest.py re-runs the miner over the reconstructed TRAIN fold and reproduces glossary.json BYTE-IDENTICAL (sha256 f5101f6c...), from 317 (city, meeting) pairs across 22 cities. THE LEAKAGE IS WORSE THAN THE TICKET ASSUMED: the glossary's fold is the eval harness hash-split, NOT the fine-tune's training manifest, and it covers MORE of the benchmark. Of the 253 common windows, 178 are in the glossary fold, 148 in the fine-tune train, 213 in at least one - only 40 are disjoint from BOTH. So 65 of the 105 windows the ticket called 'training-disjoint' are contaminated for a glossary arm, and bench_data.training_meetings() is the WRONG line to split on. Codex adds that even those 40 are not clean held-out, since the benchmark was already used developmentally when the global list was abandoned - so any glossary arm is exploratory, not confirmatory. DISTILLATION: from 3,543 per-city candidates, 853 passed the filters but only 35 carried category evidence (818 left as 'unverified' and NOT proposed); from 748 acronym candidates, 14 survived cross-city with expansions from gpt-5.6-luna; from 173 institutional/legal proposals, ZERO survived. Final: 47 terms for human review. The 5,894-term global list contributed nothing.
experiments.decision: USER DECISION 2026-08-16: the 'no terms from transcripts' rule is WITHDRAWN as a category error - a correction lexicon is not a training set, and transcripts are the correct source because they carry the terms that actually recur. Admission is now governed by COLLISION SAFETY, not provenance: a term earns its place if it recurs across meetings and cannot be confused with ordinary language. That test already exists and already works (it cut AMEA, a genuine term, at 88.9 similarity against the everyday word 'amesa'; AMEA stays out). The split survives FOR MEASUREMENT ONLY: any arm using these lists reports on windows disjoint from the mining fold (40 of 253 here), because that is the number that predicts an unmined city. Recorded in docs/decisions/data.md. The 47 candidates are admissible on provenance grounds; per-term human review is still outstanding.

experiments.title: Human-verified reference with speaker labels and overlap
experiments.question: What are the fidelity-to-audio WER, the deletion rate against what was actually said, and the speaker-attribution accuracy - overall and inside overlap - of our systems on council audio nobody has touched?
experiments.conclusion: THE HEADLINE QUESTION WAS NOT ANSWERED AND MUST NOT BE REPORTED AS IF IT WERE: W, the per-column composition of exp-2026-08-16-composition-over-selection, COULD NOT BE RUN on this audio - it is defined over ElevenLabs Scribe v2 + Soniox + the adapter and no ElevenLabs credential exists in this environment (checked .env, shell env, the OpenCouncil repos; the benchmark API only runs its own windows; GPU spend forbidden). W's added-word precision remains UNMEASURED. | WHAT WAS MEASURED, on 27 cores / 6 meetings / 6 cities, 999 certain tokens in the declared primary core-envelope region, meeting-cluster bootstrap (6 clusters, descriptive not significance): (1) FIDELITY-TO-AUDIO, the first ever in this project. ADP (artifact-adapter-fixed) 0.284 [0.169,0.455], deletions 0.116; PUB (the PUBLISHED OpenCouncil pipeline output) 0.198 [0.102,0.327], deletions 0.121; the anchored prefill 0.230. Paired ADP-PUB = +0.086 [+0.035,+0.135] - but the RANKING IS NOT REGION-INVARIANT: core-strict reverses it to -0.091 [-0.232,-0.022] while the full clip agrees with the envelope (+0.061). NO SYSTEM RANKING IS CLAIMED. (2) THE CANDIDATE AUDIT, in place of the W question and built from ADP+PUB alone with the gold consulted only afterwards under multiset capacity: 53 of 66 token occurrences that PUB has and ADP does not are SUPPORTED BY THE HUMAN REFERENCE, 80.3%, meeting CI [0.647,0.979], 5 informative meetings. Four times in five, a word a second system has and ours lacks was really said. This is a corpus audit yield, NOT W's precision. (3) 116 certain gold tokens are ADP deletions (11.6%); 104 of them (89.7%) are lexically witnessed by PUB and/or Soniox - witnessed, NOT recoverable. (4) SPEAKER ATTRIBUTION, never measured before anywhere in this project, PUB only (the adapter has no diarization), permutation locked once per cell and reused inside overlap: conditional accuracy 0.984 overall and 0.994 inside overlap, but that conditions on tokens PUB already recognised and is NOT overlap performance; the informative figure is speaker-attributed RECALL, 0.815 overall and 0.714 inside overlap - 62 of 217 certain simultaneous-speech tokens never reach a correct speaker. (5) WHAT THE PIPELINE DROPS: 8 of 137 gold blocks (5.8% [0.8%,10.2%]) have NO published utterance overlapping them in time at all; PUB's lexical deletion rate against the audio is 0.121. Observed absence of coverage - the applyDiarization SKIPPING branch is NOT proven, there is no production log. (6) ONE SPEAKER PER UTTERANCE, 38 overlap blocks in core: 12 have zero of their words in the published text, 23 are attributed to the same published speaker as their overlap partner, 21 show a single speaker; 201 of 270 tokens survive (0.744 [0.581,0.896]). (7) THE OMISSION DETECTOR COULD NOT BE RE-ESTIMATED: exactly ONE 'pyannote says speech, your text has none' flag in 27 cells, adjudicated non-speech. The 0.320 of exp-2026-08-16-pyannote-transcription is neither updated nor validated, and its 'lower bound' label is WITHDRAWN as unproven. (8) A different flag stream did work: of 106 'the published text has words here' prompts, the human called 17 (16.0%) real lost speech - and those 17 were NOT added to the frozen reference, so the reference knowingly under-covers and PUB is charged insertions for speech that happened. (9) AGREEMENT IS NOT FIDELITY: WER(ADP vs PUB) 0.304 vs WER(ADP vs gold) 0.284, with agreement LOWER in 8 of 25 cells - a different quantity, not a correctable offset.
experiments.decision: Freeze the set as a challenge set; this was its one confirmatory pass and nothing was tuned on it. Do NOT quote any system ranking from it: the ADP-vs-PUB order flips between scoring regions. Do NOT quote 0.803 as W's added-word precision, and do not quote 0.994 as overlap speaker accuracy - the overlap number that means something is the 0.714 recall. The open work item is to obtain a Scribe v2 credential and run W on this audio; until then the ticket's headline question is unanswered. The pipeline-loss findings (5.8% of blocks temporally uncovered, 12 of 38 overlap blocks entirely absent, 28.6% of certain overlap words unattributed) are the first evidence that a share of what this project has called 'model deletions' is produced downstream of the model, and they belong in any future deletion work.
caveats: W WAS NOT RUN. No ElevenLabs credential in this environment and no GPU budget. Every number here describes ADP, the published pipeline, the anchored prefill, or Soniox as a witness - never W.

THE RANKING IS NOT REGION-INVARIANT. ADP-PUB is +0.086 on the declared primary envelope and on the clip (+0.061) but -0.091 on core-strict. The utterance-timestamp explanation for the reversal is plausible and UNPROVEN: the two regions also hold different content (486 vs 999 certain tokens).

Six meetings, one meeting per city, so MEETING AND CITY ARE FULLY CONFOUNDED. Cluster-bootstrap intervals over 6 clusters are descriptive sensitivity summaries; a CI excluding zero here is not statistical significance and no p-value is quoted.

19% of core-envelope tokens (233 of 1232) sit in blocks the human marked text-uncertain and are excluded from every denominator, WITH THEIR TIME MASKED OUT of the scored intervals. Without that masking every WER on this set roughly doubled - the system words spoken over an uncertain block returned as insertions. The bug was found and fixed before any number was read.

The reference is prefilled from pyannote precision-2 + whisper-turbo and corrected, so it is anchored toward a Whisper-family system; ADP is Whisper-family, PUB is Scribe-family. That anchoring would tend to flatter ADP, which is the opposite of the measured direction, so it does not explain PUB's advantage - but no bound on it exists. The 3 blind calibration cells show the listener neither copied the prefill nor was independent of it (12/5/11 token occurrences written blind that the prefill never had); 3 non-random cells with a post-exposure 'final' bound nothing.

The 17 spans the human judged as lost speech were NOT written into the frozen reference: pass 3 records a verdict only and cannot edit blocks. The reference therefore knowingly under-covers, and PUB's fidelity WER is conservative by that much.
The candidate audit's 66 occurrences come from 5 informative meetings and are not 66 independent trials. The naive token interval [0.692,0.881] is reported as naive and must not headline.

'104 of 116 ADP deletions are witnessed' is lexical witnessing under multiset capacity. It says nothing about timing, speaker, or the insertion cost of actually restoring them, and Soniox's witness covers the whole 35 s clip rather than the scored core, which makes it optimistic.
Speaker attribution is measured for PUB only. The adapter emits no speaker labels, so it has no speaker metric and adding a diarizer would define a different system.
The overlap stratum is 'overlap pyannote can see'. pyannote's own overlap recall stays out of scope and is not estimable from this set. Unweighted results are not population estimates.
One listener, one pass, no second annotator: there is no inter-annotator number and the intervals do not include the reference's own error.
Pass 1 (blind overlap judgement) was unusable as recorded and NO metric here touches it. Pass 2 is the authority throughout.

experiments.title: A term list inside the fusion selector: free phonetic repair against an LLM selector
experiments.question: Does the distance to the oracle close if the fusion selector sees a closed term list (per-meeting roster + per-city frozen terms + error-mined candidates) and may only correct towards a list term, only where the systems disagree?
experiments.conclusion: The free control wins and the LLM selector is actively harmful. V+E (frozen phonetic closed-list repair on the vote's chosen text, no LLM) gives WER 0.1201 -> 0.1193, -0.00083 [-0.00119,-0.00049], CI excludes zero, LOO over windows sign-stable, 36 windows better / 205 tied / 6 worse. Both preregistered rate gates pass IDENTICALLY, not marginally: del_rate 0.0247 -> 0.0247 and ins_rate 0.0443 -> 0.0443 are unchanged to the digit, because the repair only ever moves substitutions (0.0512 -> 0.0503). It recovers 6.0% of the V-to-trio-oracle gap and 4.0% of the gap to the 9-system oracle. The LLM selector FAILS its deletion gate on every variant: del_rate 0.0247 -> 0.0349 (+41% relative) and WER 0.1201 -> 0.1307 (V+L+E), i.e. it loses a full point. Against the free control, V+E beats V+L+E by -0.01144 [-0.01534,-0.00753]. The preregistered justification threshold for the LLM (>=10% of the 0.0129 oracle gap V+E still leaves, i.e. >=0.00129) was missed by sign, not by size: the 'improvement' is -0.01144. WHAT THE LLM DOES: the vote picks Soniox 115 / Scribe 108 / ours 24; the LLM picks Scribe 215 / Soniox 28 / ours 1, deviating on 129 of 247 windows. All damage is on those 129 (WER 0.1072 -> 0.1290, del 0.0174 -> 0.0370). The dominant transition is Soniox -> Scribe on 95 windows: +790 deletions, -514 insertions, -1304 words. In 103 of 129 deviations the LLM chose the SHORTER text, and its choices match the oracle-best hypothesis in only 97/247 windows against the vote's 145/247. No single window (6.7% of the damage), meeting (6.8%) or city carries it; leave-one-out over windows, meetings and cities produces zero sign flips. Separately, the LLM's mechanically enforced replacements are slightly positive - V+L vs V+Lsel is -0.00021 [-0.00036,-0.00008] - but that recovers 0.021 points inside a pipeline losing 1.14, and it is the effect of the whole enforcement procedure, not of free LLM editing. Of 91 proposed replacements only 28 survived (29 over the arm-E distance budget, 11 ambiguous source, 10 on tokens all three systems agreed on, 4 not single tokens, 3 absent, 3 off-list, 3 no-ops).

The LLM selector is CLOSED: a reader that cannot hear the audio prefers the transcript that reads well, which is the one that swallowed the hard passages, and the deletion gate catches it. This is the same shape as exp-2026-08-02-asr-fusion, where the free vote took 1.1 of the 1.45 points and the LLM added nothing. Do not re-open a text-only selector without an audio-grounded signal. FOLLOW-UP 2026-08-17: the deployment half of this decision is now settled by exp-2026-08-11-name-repair, which re-measured E on W and CLOSED it SHADOW-ONLY. 'Deploy'/'ships' here means wired behind the Bhma-3 shadow gates, not switched on: four of the six gates cannot be evaluated without a name-level adjudication never done for W, and the >=300-activatable-points gate is unassessable on a holdout with no rosters. experiments.title: Composition over selection: word-level fusion of three ASR hypotheses
experiments.question: Does composing a new transcript word by word from three aligned hypotheses beat choosing whole windows, and do a length guard, an LLM arbiter and speaker-grounded restoration add to it?
experiments.conclusion: The free per-column vote wins by the largest margin this project has measured on this benchmark, and all three additions fail. W (exact 3-way sum-of-pairs MSA + hierarchical per-column vote, NO LLM, no audio, no speaker information) takes WER 0.1201 -> 0.1005, -0.01966 [-0.02292,-0.01665], and lowers ALL THREE components at once: del 0.0247 -> 0.0203 [-0.00608,-0.00270], ins 0.0443 -> 0.0374 [-0.00963,-0.00420], sub 0.0512 -> 0.0427 [-0.00995,-0.00697]. Every CI excludes zero, both preregistered rate gates pass, 208 of 247 windows improve / 10 tie / 29 worsen, and leave-one-out over windows, meetings AND cities produces zero sign flips. THE CEILING MOVED: W lands BELOW the whole-window trio oracle (0.1064) and within 0.001 of the nine-system whole-window oracle (0.0995), because its output is a text none of the three systems produced - whole-window selection is not an upper bound on composition. The NEW per-position ceiling is the ALIGNMENT-CONDITIONAL COLUMN ORACLE at 0.0475, less than half the 0.1064 whole-window oracle (-0.05891 [-0.06441,-0.05394]); it ranges 0.0461-0.0479 across the seven alignments measured and is NOT an attainable or alignment-free ceiling. W recovers 143% of the V-to-trio-oracle gap, 95% of the nine-system one and 27% of the column-oracle gap. THE THREE ADDITIONS: W+L (LLM arbitrating only the 2,066 tie-broken columns, 2.6%, mechanically restricted to returning an INDEX into that column's own candidates) gives -0.00021 [-0.00083,+0.00042] over W - NO DETECTED BENEFIT, which is not the same as 'adds nothing' (one model, one prompt, one run, 141 of 2,066 answers invalid or missing, no equivalence margin). Notably it also does no HARM, unlike the wide-job LLM selector of exp-2026-08-16-roster-grounded-selection which cost a full point. W+len FAILS the insertion gate (0.0467 > 0.0443) at WER 0.1108: reverting to V whenever W is shorter throws the win away, because W is SUPPOSED to be shorter. W+D FAILS the insertion gate (0.0478) at 0.1087, +0.00822 [+0.00601,+0.01075] worse than W: of 2,430 dropped runs it restored 342 (315 on >=2 simultaneous pyannote speakers, 27 on a disjoint speaker set, 899 tokens), which cut deletions to 0.0187 but bought more insertions than it was worth. THE DECLARED TIMESTAMP RISK, answered: W and W+L are pure text and never touch a timestamp, so it cannot reach the winning arm. D is the only arm that needs time and it reads the worst part of the timeline - over the 8.6% of matched token pairs where at least one side is INTERPOLATED rather than anchored, the two independently derived times disagree by p90 1.56 s / p95 2.98 s / p99 10.42 s (79.0% under 0.5 s), against p95 0.00 s over all 199,971 pairs, a figure that is an artefact of both-anchored pairs sharing one pyannote timestamp by construction.
experiments.decision: W is the fusion arm from here: per-column composition replaces whole-window selection, and the trio whole-window oracle stops being the number to chase. Do not ship W+len, W+D or W+L. The next step is NOT another arm on this substrate - it is whether W survives on audio this project has never scored. The D result must not be read as 'speaker information does not help': it was never given a usable timeline, and the overlap-conditioned finding of exp-2026-08-16-pyannote-transcription still stands.
caveats: THIRD PASS over the same 247 windows. Freezing the design does not remove adaptive-overfitting pressure across passes, and Codex job 7634f308 named it the first thing to rule out. The 34 windows disjoint from BOTH the glossary mining fold and the fine-tune training manifest (23 meetings, 10,150 reference tokens, no clustered CIs, underpowered) point the same way - V 0.1236, W 0.1100, W+L 0.1083, whole-window trio oracle 0.1131, column oracle 0.0520 - but that is directional support, not validation.

NO CLAIM OF GENERALISATION. Leave-one-out shows no existing cluster drives the result; it does not show the result survives on untouched audio. The trio itself was selected against these same references upstream (exp-2026-08-02-asr-fusion) and has never been confirmed on untouched audio.
NOTHING ABOUT SPEAKER-ATTRIBUTION ACCURACY. There is no ground truth; it waits for wayfinder #21. The D arm's speaker rule is judged only by what it does to WER/del/ins/sub.

The column oracle is ALIGNMENT-CONDITIONAL hindsight potential, not an attainable ceiling. Every one of the six progressive orderings gives a WORSE W and four of six give a BETTER oracle - hindsight exploits recombination that a suboptimal alignment opens and no implementable voter can use. Quote the range 0.0461-0.0479, never 0.0475 alone as 'the ceiling'.

'143% of the trio-oracle gap' and '95% of the nine-system gap' compare unlike search spaces and neither means saturation. The fair statement is that whole-window selection is not an upper bound on composition; 'composition is not bounded by selection' is too broad (Codex job 7634f308).

The W+L null is NOT 'the LLM adds nothing'. It is 'no statistically detected incremental WER benefit from this implemented arm': one model (gpt-5.6-luna, effort low), one prompt, one stochastic run, 141 of 2,066 answers invalid or missing, and no preregistered equivalence margin.
NO MULTIPLICITY CORRECTION. Five arms and several contrasts share the 95% level. W's margin is wide; W+L's is not.
Agreement-with-OpenCouncil, not fidelity-to-audio. 'W recovers deletions' means it recovers words present in OUR reference text.

experiments.title: Does the deletion-hard training supply teach omission?
experiments.question: Do the deletion-hard training rows carry target text that does not cover the speech in their clip, so the model is taught to stay silent over uncovered audio - and do the two screens' new deletions concentrate in one mechanically explainable category?
experiments.conclusion: NEITHER FROZEN GATE IS ESTABLISHED; under a proof-to-reopen rule the training freeze holds. Gate (b) is cleanly not met: the new deletions of both arms on the 39 frozen windows are 67.7% (RUN1) / 72.2% (RUN2) 'ordinary speech', which is the RESIDUAL category and not a mechanical explanation; the largest mechanical category is names at 18.0% / 11.8% against a >40% threshold. That holds under an alternative category precedence (edge>overlap>name), under a flipped alignment tie-break, and when contiguous runs are counted as single events (RUN1 n=104, ordinary 75.0%). Gate (a) is NOT DEMONSTRATED and NOT CONCLUSIVELY ADJUDICATED. Soniox witnesses exist for only 2,661 of the 3,921 deletion_hard rows, and the 1,260 without one are exactly the pre-wave HUMAN-reviewed stratum, so the audit measures the auto-verified stratum and structurally cannot measure the human one. On the witnessed rows the conservative estimator gives 10.75% over the 1.0 s gate (286 rows), ~8-9% if the measured proxy calibration transports, 9.39% duration-matched over the full bucket, 7.29% as a cohort lower bound. Reaching 15% cohort-wide would require a 24.0% positive rate among the 1,260 unwitnessed rows against ~6.5% implied by duration matching - unlikely, but not excluded. The ticket froze a threshold and not an ESTIMATOR: a deliberately loose upper-bound estimator (every difflib `replace` counted as uncovered) gives 22.7% witnessed = 605 rows = 15.4% of the whole cohort even counting every unwitnessed row as clean, i.e. it passes. That is recorded, not hidden; the conservative estimator is read as primary because it answers the ticket's own wording ('speech matching NO word of the target') and was fixed before any number existed. SUBSTANCE, none of it gate-passing: coverage is bimodal, not uniformly degraded - 67.2% of witnessed rows have ZERO uncovered tokens, median uncovered 0.0 s, p90 1.08 s, and the worst 5% of rows carry half of all uncovered seconds. The uncovered dose is 6.79% of clip audio against 3.78% on the 300 cleanliness-audited backbone rows, a pipeline-estimated ratio that is strongly duration-confounded (median 4.36 s vs 1.58 s) and not a clean 1.8x excess. In absolute terms ~22 minutes of uncovered audio in a 45.2 h mix = 0.81% of audio, ~1.26% exposure-weighted. That arithmetic does NOT falsify the causal hypothesis (repeated sampling, disproportionate loss and a global blank/speech operating-point shift can all amplify a small contaminated exposure, and the simultaneous substitution drop is consistent with such a shift) but it does not make target truncation the likely explanation either; only an ablation - retraining after filtering - would decide. Clip edges cut the target's own first or last word in 37.0% of the 2,655 testable deletion-hard rows (17.5% head, 23.8% tail) - against 69.7% on the 89 testable backbone comparison rows, i.e. NOT elevated in the deletion-hard bucket. Edge cutting tracks clip DURATION (backbone median 1.58 s vs 4.36 s), reproducing what exp-2026-08-09-clip-boundaries found by blind listening, and it is directionally OPPOSITE to the uncovered-speech hypothesis: it teaches output without acoustic support, not silence over speech. The realized mixture is the larger anomaly: dropping every flagged row moves 68.9/18.6/2.6/10.0 to 70.2/17.2/2.6/10.0, while the executed mix is already 4x under its own design on names (2.6% vs 10%) - and names are the one mechanical category enriched in the new deletions (6.8x over base rate in RUN1, 4.4x in RUN2), matching the DS-WER v2 entities S->D swap. Two candidate explanations therefore stay open with no causal support: mixture composition (better localized evidence) and target noise (a plausible global mechanism, no localized evidence).
experiments.decision: Training stays frozen for this cycle. No retrain, no GPU spend. If it is ever reopened for another reason, three zero-cost changes are ready: drop the 286 flagged rows, pad clip boundaries, and restore the names dose to its designed 10%.
caveats: The seconds figure is a PROXY (uncovered_tokens x clip_duration / n_soniox_tokens): Soniox was run text-only and word timestamps were never saved. Calibrated against cached whisper-turbo word timestamps over 16,395 draws whose pseudo-clip durations are weighted to the audited rows' own duration distribution: estimate/true ratio median 1.32, p90 2.81, median absolute error 0.48 s, precision 0.830 / recall 0.980 at the 1.0 s gate, and 73.3% true positives in the 1-3 s estimate band where the flagged rows actually sit. The calibration validates the tokens->seconds step only, never that a Soniox token was really spoken, and its transport from benchmark windows to training clips is assumed, not shown.

1,260 of 3,921 deletion_hard rows (the pre-wave human-reviewed stratum) have no witness and were never measured. 'Gate not established' is not 'no gap exists', and a cohort-level FAILURE is not provable from these data.

The 300 backbone rows are a false-positive floor for the pipeline, not an unbiased control: they were selected for cleanliness and their median duration is 1.58 s against 4.36 s. Do not read 6.79% vs 3.78% causally.

Edge-cut rates are over TESTABLE rows only (both a Soniox exact and a padded transcript that align): 2,655 of 2,661 deletion-hard rows but only 89 of 300 backbone rows. experiments.title: Per-character voting and homophone arbitration on top of the per-column composition
experiments.question: Does WER fall below W's 0.1005 using the same three systems, with a per-character vote inside disagreement columns (C) and homophone arbitration (H), measured leave-one-city-out?
experiments.conclusion: NO, and the census answered it before either arm was built. Of 80,659 alignment columns only 34 are strict-homophone columns an arm H could touch - 0.042%, seven times below the user's standing 0.3% do-not-build line - so H was NOT BUILT (no KenLM, no LLM). Arm C was built because it is text-only and cheap: out-of-fold over 10 leave-one-city-out folds it gives 0.10046 -> 0.10038, -0.00008 [-0.00026,+0.00009], CI INCLUDES ZERO, so it fails the primary gate. Both rate gates pass identically to the digit (empirically, not by construction: C cannot change the token count but a substitution can still move the scorer's alignment). C fired on all 136 eligible columns: 57 composites reproduced W's own token, 58 produced a different candidate, 2 produced a string no system proposed that the closed lexicon admitted, 19 were rejected off-lexicon. 49 of 247 windows changed, 16 better / 218 tied / 13 worse, 5 cities better / 4 worse, zero LOO sign flips of an effect indistinguishable from zero. THE STRUCTURAL FINDING is what survives: the 5.30-point gap between W (0.1005) and the alignment-conditional column oracle (0.0475) is NOT mostly in the columns where the three systems disagree about which word was said. Only 1,396 unresolved columns have W differing from the oracle, so one full edit gained per column would close at most 35.2% of the gap, and a hindsight replay over EVERY unresolved column closes 12.7%. The same replay over exact 2-of-3 token majorities closes 25.0% - twice every unresolved column together - and over occupancy columns 14.2%, taking deletions 0.0203 -> 0.0124 while pushing insertions 0.0374 -> 0.0391 and failing the frozen insertion gate even with hindsight. In the agree class the oracle disagrees with W ZERO times: it never drops or replaces a token all three systems produced.
experiments.decision: C does not ship and H is not implemented. Word-choice arbitration between these three transcripts is a small room and both arms of #24 are inside it. The next lever is NOT another per-column arbiter over the same three texts: the mass sits where the systems agree, or agree 2-of-1, and are wrong together, which is exactly where their text carries no signal. Codex forbade the stronger reading that text-only arbitration is exhausted in general - what is shown is that arbitration restricted to THESE sparse eligible sets has little demonstrated value.
caveats: FIFTH PASS over the same 247 windows / 144 meetings / 10 cities / 74,917 reference tokens. Freezing a design does not remove adaptive-overfitting pressure across passes.

NOT a clean out-of-sample estimate. The common-word set is properly cross-fitted leave-one-city-out, but it changed 2 decisions in the whole substrate, so LOCO is technically real and practically inert here. The city term lists and rosters were mined from material overlapping this benchmark and are NOT cross-fitted, and the class definitions were chosen after four previous passes over these same windows. experiments.title: An autonomous idea-search harness over fusion_lab with an explicit multiple-comparisons defence
experiments.question: Can an automated loop propose and score ideas on top of W without manufacturing a false positive, and what does its first small run find?
experiments.conclusion: THE HARNESS EXISTS AND THE FIRST RUN FOUND NOTHING, which is the honest outcome for a smoke test. Denominator: 11 ideas registered, 11 evaluated on the search partition, 1 refused as a cosmetic variant, 0 passed the search screen, 0 of 5 confirmations spent, confirmation partition never read. The 10 benchmark cities are cut once by an outcome-blind token-balance rule into SEARCH (athens, chalandri, chania, orestiada, vrilissia, zografou - 153 windows, 103 meetings, 47,252 ref tokens, W=0.09280) and CONFIRM (argos, samothraki, sparta, xylokastro - 94 windows, 61 meetings, 27,665 ref tokens, W=0.11354); each side holds one city that contributed nothing to fine-tuning. The defence, protocol autoresearch-2026-08-16b, after Codex job 362e2a7b rewrote three parts of the design and job 59c9564 found eight implementation defects: the split is ENFORCED by the API (run_search refuses a substrate holding a confirmation city, run_confirmation refuses anything but the whole confirmation partition); EXACTLY ONE confirmation batch is frozen per cycle before any confirmation number exists, because five sequential singleton batches each Holm-corrected inside themselves give a familywise error of 22.6%; the p-value is a null-imposed studentized wild cluster bootstrap-t over meetings with shared Rademacher weights, NOT the percentile tail mass, which is centred on the observed effect and is not a p-value under H0; THE SHIP TEST IS A ONE-SIDED MINIMUM-EFFECT TEST of H0: dWER >= -0.0010, Holm-corrected at familywise 0.05, because testing against zero is the wrong test when a MONOTONE arm touching 4 meeting clusters excites a percentile CI at any effect size; BH is reported beside Holm as description only, since its guarantee needs independence or PRDS which shared bootstrap weights do not establish. A support floor (>= 8 meetings with a NON-ZERO error delta) and a single-item domination check sit beside the test. The journal is hash-chained WITH a tail checkpoint (the chain alone accepts any prefix, so deleting the tail would be invisible) and every read-decide-append runs inside one file lock; the dedup guard fails closed when its cache is gone. Measured under the exact null with the harness's own inference code: P(some idea has raw p<0.05) is 0.207 / 0.415 / 0.873 at 5 / 10 / 40 ideas, while P(some idea ships under Holm) stays 0.060 / 0.055 / 0.055, and marginal p is calibrated (P(p<0.05)=0.046-0.054). RESULTS OF THE FIRST RUN, all negative: three text-only rules for overriding a 2-of-3 token majority - the class holding 25.0% of the W-to-oracle gap in hindsight - cost +0.16, +0.25 and +0.27 WER points, each with a CI excluding zero on the WRONG side and each worse in all six search cities. Learnable occupancy restoration at singleton columns halves deletions (0.01737 -> 0.00916) and more than doubles insertions (0.03486 -> 0.07240) for +2.85 points, which is the #24 hindsight insertion-gate failure reproduced and amplified. Re-arbitration of unresolved columns gave +0.00021, p=0.25, as its declared poor-bet status predicted. TWO IDEAS FIRED ON ZERO COLUMNS and would have looked like clean zeros with both rate gates passing to the digit; only the firing-set size revealed they were never tested. The deliberately restyled copy of an evaluated rule was refused by the behavioural dedup guard before it could be scored twice.
experiments.decision: Use the harness for any further idea search on this substrate; do not evaluate ideas against W outside it. Nothing from this run ships and nothing is quoted as a result about the model: no idea reached the screen, so no confirmation batch was frozen and all 5 confirmations remain. The only directional signal - two_present_oov_drop moved insertions 0.03486 -> 0.03304 while losing on deletions - is recorded in the journal as a hypothesis to beat, not as a finding. The majority-override family is now negative on measurement as well as on argument and should not be retried in a fourth costume.
caveats: CLARIFICATION 2026-08-17 (exp-2026-08-17-confirmation-audit): 'confirmation partition never read' is accurate about the HARNESS - journal.jsonl holds zero CONFIRM_BATCH_FROZEN and zero CONFIRM_RESULT, and all search results ran on 153 windows. It is not a claim about analyst knowledge: six reference-conditioned passes over all 247 windows, confirmation cities included, preceded and followed it, which is why the partition is invalid as confirmation for the LLM-composer family F1. The journal now holds 16 registered / 16 searched, not 11 / 11: the five overlap-speaker arms of exp-2026-08-16-overlap-speaker-arms were appended later at git_head 437993d9, and all five ran on search only.
Smoke test of the harness, not a result about the model. Eleven ideas is not a search.

Sixth pass over the same 247 windows. Sample splitting controls the multiplicity of TESTING, not the adaptivity of PROPOSING: these ideas were written by an agent that has read five prior reports about this substrate, confirmation cities included. Round 2 of the seed set was written after seeing round 1's search numbers.

The partitions are not exchangeable: W is 0.09280 on search and 0.11354 on confirm, column oracle 0.03847 vs 0.06286. experiments.title: Overlap-restricted speaker-conditioned arms on W, and a per-speaker omission rule
experiments.question: Does the parent experiment's inside-overlap speaker advantage transfer onto W, and does an omission rule that counts speakers see the lost speaker inside simultaneous speech?
experiments.conclusion: TWO ANSWERS, ONE NEGATIVE AND ONE POSITIVE, AND THE NEGATIVE MUST NOT BE OVERSTATED. (1) THE OVERLAP SPEAKER-CUT ADVANTAGE WAS NOT DEMONSTRATED ON TOP OF W. Preregistered primary, on a cut-INDEPENDENT mask (each detected-overlap interval plus its two neighbouring turns; every arm token-identical to W outside it; the placebo dose-matched to the speaker cuts INSIDE the mask, 0 windows unmatched, 20 draws resampled inside the bootstrap): turn minus placebo = +0.00094, CI [-0.00600,+0.00833], which contains zero AND contains the parent's -0.00558. THIS IS A FAILED DEMONSTRATION, NOT A DEMONSTRATED FAILURE: two-sided power against an effect that size was about 33%, the 80% MDE is about 0.0103, and only 43 of 103 meeting clusters carried a non-zero contribution because in 80 of 153 windows the speaker partition places no cut inside the mask at all. The composing variant gives -0.00012 [-0.00444,+0.00437]. What IS established is operational: W is the best thing inside its own overlap neighbourhood (mask error 0.23553 vs 0.25191 for turn-selection and 0.26018 for mask-selection), the three selection-shaped arms cost +0.0022 to +0.0036 WER against W with CIs excluding zero, the two composition-shaped arms are unresolved (+0.0002), every arm's deletion rate rose, and ALL FIVE FAILED THE SEARCH SCREEN. ZERO OF FIVE CONFIRMATIONS SPENT - and none would have been spent even on a pass, because the hypothesis was generated on all 247 windows including the sealed confirmation cities, which was written into the preregistration before anything ran. Mask exposure 6,411 of 47,252 reference tokens (13.6%). (2) THE PER-SPEAKER OMISSION RULE WORKS AND ITS SPEAKER TERM DOES REAL WORK. Hybrid rule: outside overlap the shipped zero-word rule unchanged; inside overlap missing(I) = |S| - obs/(rho_single*dur) with an INCLUSIVE threshold of 1.0, eligibility rho_single*dur >= 3 = MIN_DEL_RUN, rho_single estimated on single-speaker intervals only and cross-fitted leave-one-city-out (2.438 pooled). Recall 0.1075 -> 0.2020 (+0.0945 [+0.0581,+0.1323], CI excludes zero); against a DURATION-ONLY comparator (the same rule with |S| forced to 1) on exactly the same 6,425 eligible intervals and held to the same merged-alert budget (244 vs 243 flags, and MORE flagged seconds: 618 vs 550), precision is +0.0543 [+0.0042,+0.1089], CI excludes zero, 81 of 144 meetings contributing, largest leave-one-meeting-out shift 17%. That is the preregistered primary and the first evidence here that detected speaker multiplicity carries information a duration rule does not. THE PRICE: 243 merged flags instead of 107 at an observed precision 5.3 points lower whose CI CONTAINS ZERO - a higher-sensitivity, higher-workload operating point, not a free upgrade. The whole speaker term rests on 214 overlap intervals. On exclusiveDiarization the rule degenerates to the old rule by construction (122 flags, 0.3361/0.1336), which is a construction check and not a comparison. The old rule scores 0.3084 here against its published 0.361 purely because event scoring is now stricter (adjacent flags merged, one-to-one matching); that is not degradation and the two must never be quoted as before-and-after. GOLD SET: 4 flags in 27 cells, below the threshold the preregistration set in advance, so NOTHING is claimed and the withdrawn 'lower bound' label on the detector's precision STAYS WITHDRAWN. Zero new pyannoteAI calls (both timelines already cached), zero GPU.
experiments.decision: Do not patch W inside detected overlap with anything built here - selection-shaped patches are measurably worse and composition-shaped ones buy nothing. Do NOT record the speaker-cut question as answered: the interval contains the effect it was built to reproduce, and re-asking it needs more overlap material or an estimand not diluted by the 80 windows where the treatment is inert. DO adopt the speaker-aware omission rule as the candidate-mining signal for exp-2026-08-13-targeted-deletion-training, at the explicitly stated operating point (2.27x the alerts for 1.88x the recall), and quote its precision only against the budget-matched duration-only comparator, never against the old rule as if the precision loss were established or absent.
caveats: NO CONFIRMATION WAS SPENT AND NONE COULD HAVE BEEN. The hypothesis was generated by exp-2026-08-16-pyannote-transcription on all 247 windows, the four sealed confirmation cities included, so hiding them during implementation buys nothing. All 5 confirmations remain and the confirmation partition was never read.

Experiment 1's primary is a NULL WITH LOW POWER: CI [-0.00600,+0.00833] contains the parent's -0.00558, so no claim of non-transfer is entitled. A large benefit inside the mask is ruled out; an effect of the previously reported size is not, in either direction.

The three Experiment 1 estimands are different quantities - the parent's overlap-local selection contrast, the mask-local error rate here, and whole-window WER. Their magnitudes must not be subtracted from each other.

Codex 5851725675b5 (high effort) reviewed the preregistration BEFORE any number existed and found twelve defects, four of them design-changing: the confirmation partition is not confirmatory here; the treated region was cut-dependent, which would have let the placebo lose by replacing more text; the first density threshold PROVABLY COULD NOT FIRE on the exact one-lost-speaker case it was designed for (two speakers with one transcribed normally scores exactly 0.5*rho against a strict '<'), which is why the quantity became a count of missing speakers; and the detector's random null tested a claim nobody disputes. Codex 8c1e7bbb2020 reviewed the findings before the report's text and killed four sentences.
Agreement-with-OpenCouncil throughout except the gold-set section. A detector true positive means our text disagrees with the published reference, not that a human heard speech there.

The duration-only comparator's threshold was calibrated on the evaluation corpus to match the alert budget, and the bootstrap treats it as fixed rather than recalibrating inside each replicate; +0.0543 is conditional on that calibration.

experiments.title: Does artifact-adapter-fixed's own per-word confidence predict its errors, and is it the same signal as Soniox's?
experiments.question: faster-whisper returns a real per-word probability when word_timestamps=True, and our serving code already exposes it, but the 247-window benchmark decode ran with word_timestamps=false so no word probability was ever computed. Does asking for it change the transcript? Does the probability predict human-verified errors? And is it the SAME signal as Soniox confidence or a complementary one - which is what decides how much a confidence-weighted fusion vote can possibly gain with only 2 of 3 voters.
experiments.conclusion: PRIMARY (gold set, FIDELITY-TO-AUDIO, 27 cores / 6 meetings / 6 cities, one meeting per city so meeting and city are fully confounded): the adapter's own per-word probability DOES predict its errors. Mean within-meeting AUROC of 1 - p_word = 0.8151 on 915 normalized token rows / 166 errors; within-meeting permutation null blocked on the emitted word gives null mean 0.4999, 95% [0.414, 0.587], one-sided p = 0.0005; leave-one-meeting-out 0.7997-0.8367; removing the error-dominant meeting (samothraki jul6, 61% of errors) RAISES the mean to 0.820, so it is not inflating the estimate. Bottom decile error rate 0.703 against prevalence 0.181, 3.88x lift. It is a RANKING signal - no calibrated error probability is claimed. | THE CEILING IS STRUCTURAL: deletions are 41.1% of edit operations in the scored region, so a per-word confidence can attach to only 58.9% of our damage, against Soniox's 77.2% on the same recordings. Confidence is not a route to the deletion problem. | THE CHEAP NUMBER WILL NOT DO: exp(avg_logprob), what oc_asr_server.py returns today, scores 0.611 against 0.815 and is worse in ALL SIX meetings (+0.060 to +0.342). | HEAD-TO-HEAD (shared columns only, 866 columns, a conditioned subset excluding every deletion and insertion): the two systems' ERRORS co-occur strongly (56 both against a meeting-stratified independence expectation of 21.0, odds ratio 17.8) while their CONFIDENCES do not - within-meeting Spearman 0.157-0.383, and the two bottom-decile flag sets overlap at 8 against 8.54 expected, i.e. CHANCE. Non-redundant ranking information, which is the precondition a confidence-weighted vote needed. | NO COMBINATION GAIN IS ESTABLISHED: the preregistered mean-of-percentile-ranks combination gains +0.019 and +0.028 mean AUROC, positive in 4 of 6 meetings, 6-cluster intervals [-0.013, +0.053] and [-0.015, +0.072], both including zero. | 0.8151 and Soniox's 0.8167 are SEPARATE WITHIN-SYSTEM ESTIMANDS over different emitted -token and error populations. NOT an equivalence result. | GATE: FAILED. Asking faster-whisper for word_timestamps CHANGES THE TRANSCRIPT. On 102 paired windows the raw text is identical in 0 and the normalized token sequence in 1 (and that one differs only in punctuation/spacing); pooled WER between the two settings 0.0770 with the wt=False tokens as denominator, op mix S 996 / D 586 / I 678 over 29,345 tokens; per-window change rate p50 0.053, max 0.352, with the 10 most-changed windows carrying 32.1% of all edits; segment count differs in 82 of 102 windows. CONSEQUENCE: these confidences belong to THIS re-run and CANNOT be attached retroactively to the frozen fusion input W or to the cached 247-window benchmark text - the same wall the Soniox work hit from the other side, where the confidence-bearing re-run forced the parallel W-rt substrate. AND THE STACK MOVE ALONE IS ALREADY AS LARGE: cached RunPod GPU wt=False vs local CPU int8 wt=False is 0.0926 symmetric with 2 of 102 identical, so even a wt=False local pass does not reproduce the benchmark decode - this route could never have supplied confidences for the frozen text. | DELETIONS BETWEEN THE TWO SETTINGS: pooled deletion rate 0.05173 (wt=F) vs 0.05157 (wt=T), delta -0.00017, CI [-0.00727, +0.00808]. THIS IS CANCELLATION, NOT STABILITY: per-window D_true - D_false is nonzero in 82 of 102 windows, |delta| >= 10 in 18, absolute values summing to 613 against a net sum of -5, range -32 to +48, and in every large-swing window the emitted-token count moves the opposite way by nearly the same amount - whole passages appear and disappear. WER delta +0.00149 [-0.00562, +0.00935] and substitutions -0.00122 [-0.00389, +0.00120] include zero; insertions +0.00287 [+0.00003, +0.00621] only just clears zero among four unadjusted quantities on a protocol-deviating sample and is SUGGESTIVE, not established. | DESCRIPTIVE 247 ARM (AGREEMENT-WITH-OPENCOUNCIL, never merged with the gold set, and its confidences belong to the wt=True re-run not to the cached benchmark text): 102 windows, 82 meetings, 29,437 rows, 2,946 errors, prevalence 0.1001; p_word mean within-meeting AUROC 0.8412 (pooled 0.8622, AP 0.405, LOO 0.8400-0.8430, all 82 meetings defined), segment proxy 0.6048. Its numerical proximity to the gold set's 0.8151 is NOT replication, NOT validation, NOT equivalence and NOT transport between the two metrics. | THIS ARM DID NOT DELIVER WHAT IT WAS FOR: it existed to decide whether confidences could be attached to the frozen substrate, the answer is no, and the arm that would have priced the re-decode was stopped at 41% coverage with its stop rule broken.

Any consumer that wants it must re-decode with word_timestamps=True and accept a transcript that is a different substrate from the frozen benchmark and from W. | DO NOT restart the two 247-window decode passes: the gate is a conjunction, it already failed, and more windows cannot reverse it. | DO NOT claim a fusion benefit from either confidence source. exp-2026-08-16-w-rt-confidence has since closed NEGATIVE on the full 247-window W-rt substrate - the occupancy and minority-override arms each fitted a threshold that NEVER FIRES in all ten leave-one-city-out folds, and the weighted identity vote gave -0.00035 with intervals including zero - so a detector at AUROC ~0.82 bought nothing there, and its AUROC on the decisions a fusion arm actually makes is 0.587-0.703. | DO NOT name a binding constraint. THE WATCHDOG PROCESS DIED WHEN THE SESSION HIT ITS API LIMIT and the decodes overran to roughly 00:44 before being killed by hand. Per-window completion timestamps were never recorded, so the realized set CANNOT be truncated back to the 23:45 boundary and the preregistered sample cannot be reconstructed. The frozen stop rule was MECHANICALLY VIOLATED. THE 102 ARE NOT A UNIFORM SAMPLE OF THE 247. An unenforced time stop can select on RUNTIME, and runtime is not independent of what a window contains - slow, segmentation-heavy windows are the ones least likely to have finished. MEASUREMENT BUG FOUND AND FIXED WHILE CLOSING. eval/adapter_confidence_decode.py stores text as ''.join(segment.text), and faster-whisper does not always put a leading space on a segment - 505 of 1,677 segment boundaries here have none - so the joined string FUSES the last word of a segment with the first word of the next, at exactly the boundaries word_timestamps moves. The gate contrast now builds tokens PER SEGMENT. On the joined string the gate reads 0.0804; fusion-free it is 0.0770. Both fail. Only after the fix do the gate path and the descriptive path reconcile exactly (29,437 tokens, 2,946 errors both ways); the discrepancy was caught by Codex job f2d5d496bb414420a6aa490e1bb5a878.

The gate failure is NOT a claim that all 247 windows would change, nor that 0.0770 is the benchmark-wide magnitude. It is a claim that the attachment precondition is not met, which one counterexample settles.

The gold set is 27 cells / 6 meetings / 6 cities with ONE MEETING PER CITY, so meeting and city are fully confounded. It cannot support a population claim or any promotion gate; a 6-cluster interval excluding a null is not significance.

The gold reference is ONE LISTENER, ONE PASS, NO ADJUDICATION. Conclusions are fidelity to the human-verified reference UNDER ITS TRANSCRIPTION RULES, not unconstrained audio truth. 19% of core tokens were excluded as text-uncertain with their time masked out, and 17 spans judged lost speech were never written into the reference.
The gold-set decode is beam_size=2 CPU int8 on the local serving path, NOT the 247-window benchmark config (beam 5, RunPod GPU). Nothing from it is evidence about the benchmark decode's confidences.
AUROC covers substitutions and insertions among EMITTED words only. 41.1% of edit operations in the gold region are deletions, invisible by construction.

samothraki jul6 supplies 61% of the gold-set errors. The macro average protects the primary discrimination estimate; nothing prevalence-dependent is protected - pooled AUROC, average precision, the calibration table, the bottom-decile yield and any statement about the error mix all inherit it.
The head-to-head is a CONDITIONED SUBSET - no deletions by either system, no insertions. It cannot speak to overall confidence quality.

Arm O (restore a Soniox-only singleton iff conf >= tau, 3,167 eligible) fitted tau = 1.01 = NEVER FIRE IN ALL TEN FOLDS, 0 firings, dWER exactly 0. Arm M (override a 2-of-3 majority with the Soniox minority, 1,515 eligible) likewise NEVER FIRED in all ten folds. Arm A (asymmetric weighted identity vote on the 1,889-column tie set, Soniox weight = conf, other two systems constant k = 0.5 preregistered) fired 750 times, dWER -0.00035, CI95 [-0.00105,+0.00027] and adjusted CI [-0.00124,+0.00039] BOTH INCLUDE ZERO, and BOTH RATE GATES FAIL narrowly; 5 cities better 5 worse, city sign test p = 1.0; 169 firings match the column oracle against 301 that go against it. | CONTROLS: O-all (fire on everything) cuts the deletion rate ~37% (0.02050 -> 0.01285) but nearly doubles insertions (0.03557 -> 0.07020) for dWER +0.02694 and 210 of 247 windows worse - about 573 fewer deletion errors bought with about 2,594 more insertion errors. M-all gives dWER +0.01281 with substitutions 0.04323 -> 0.05608. | ATTRIBUTION: A met the preregistered permutation criterion, its observed dWER at least as favourable as ALL 200 within-meeting confidence permutations (one-sided Monte Carlo p = 0.00498) - confidence is doing something a shuffle does not, but that is attribution against a shuffle and NOT an established WER benefit. For O and M the permutation null is DEGENERATE (every replicate exactly 0.0, because the procedure declines to fire under any reassignment), so it is uninformative there. The declared k envelope for A CHANGES SIGN (+0.000013 at k=0.3 to -0.00068 at k=0.7, whose CI excludes zero), so the preregistered instability clause fired. | THE VARIANT THAT CAME CLOSEST CANNOT BE USED: O2 (take the Soniox token in unresolved_two columns iff conf >= tau) fitted tau = 0.95 in all ten folds, fired 289 of 811, and is the only arm with a reported interval entirely below zero (exploratory 95% [-0.00051,-0.00006]), with 74 of its firings matching the oracle against 8 opposing. This does NOT establish that stt-rt-v4 is generally non-inferior to stt-async-v5 as a fusion voter, and it points the other way twice: the whole-window vote is 0.12466 vs 0.12012 (worse) and the column oracle 0.04799 vs 0.04748 (the ceiling moved up). The 6 sealed temporal-holdout windows are NOT spent on this and stay sealed. | DO NOT spend the ~$0.82 stt-async-v5 confidence run proposed by exp-2026-08-16-soniox-confidence on the strength of a fusion-arm hypothesis: on the free path the fusion arms failed, and the diagnostic says why (0.59-0.70 AUROC on the decisions that matter, worst where the mass is). That run may still be justified for a different question, but not for this one. | DO NOT quote 0.8167 as if it were the discrimination available to a fusion arm. | The occupancy material IS real (O-all cuts deletions 37%) and remains unreachable by any confidence threshold on this grid - the next lever on deletions is not a per-column confidence gate. | Overriding 2-of-3 majorities has now failed a FOURTH time on this substrate, with a signal the previous three did not have.

experiments.title: What the wrong 2-of-3 majorities actually are
experiments.question: The exact_2_of_3 class holds 25% of the W-to-column-oracle gap in hindsight and three override arms all made WER worse. What ARE those errors, how many are recoverable in principle, and how many involve a term already in a frozen term list?
experiments.conclusion: THE CLASS IS NOT ONE THING AND A LARGE PART OF IT IS UNREACHABLE BY ANY VOTING RULE. Of 6,645 exact_2_of_3 columns, 1,719 (25.9%) have a wrong majority. Outcomes read off the oracle DP's OPTIMAL-SUPPORT SET rather than one backtrace: selection 1,038 (the minority token IS the reference word), coverage 318 (neither system proposed the right word), ambiguous 205 (substitution and insertion are both optimal explanations, undecidable under a unit-cost scorer), spurious 158 (the majority is an insertion). DEFINITELY NOT SELECTION: 476, 27.7%. NOT CLEANLY ATTRIBUTABLE TO SELECTION: 681, 39.6% - the honest statement is the range. Operationally, 719 of 1,719 columns (41.8%) have ZERO marginal benefit with W's other choices frozen, and a replay over exactly those saves 2 edits of 3,969; the complementary 1,000 supply 999 of the class's 1,001 edits. THE CENSUS'S 1,245 'W differs from the oracle choice' IS NOT THIS SET: 1,215 overlap, 30 are pure tie-breaks where the majority is still right, and 504 wrong majorities are missing from it because the oracle picks the same wrong token. The observation that the oracle takes the lone dissenter in 1,245 of 1,245 cases is a CANDIDATE-SET IDENTITY, not evidence of recoverability - an exact_2_of_3 column has no epsilon candidate, so a disagreeing oracle has exactly one alternative. TAXONOMY (n / share / standalone hindsight closure of the 3,969-edit gap): different_content_word 550 / 32.0% / 6.70% (heterogeneous - 222 of 550 are function-content pairs, worst yield per column at 0.48), function_word_pair 342 / 19.9% / 6.95% (the largest coherent linguistic bucket, ~28% of the measurable hindsight gain, highest yield 0.81), numeric_identifier 236 / 13.7% / 4.13%, morphology_suffix_neighbor 188 / 10.9% / 3.58%, no_target 147 / 8.6% / 0%, named_entity 110 / 6.4% / 1.03%, orthography_homophone 109 / 6.3% / 2.14%, alignment_artifact 30 / 1.7% / 0.60%, protocol_legal 7 / 0.4% / 0.05%. THE TICKET'S PRIOR THAT GREEK MORPHOLOGY WOULD DOMINATE IS NOT SUPPORTED. No class is dominated by one item: every class with n>=100 has a top-meeting share <=11.6% over 55-128 meetings. THE ENTITY CROSS-CHECK, which is what exp-2026-08-16-error-mined-terms left open: 99 wrong majorities have a reference target that is a frozen city term (67 distinct terms, 52 meetings, all 10 cities). 93 of 99 are in the window's OWN city file and 83 of 99 survive the per-meeting roster gate, so COVERAGE IS NOT THE CONSTRAINT - attrition is downstream. Running the frozen name_repair.select() on the wrong token: fire 36, no_candidate 33, abstain_already_valid 9, abstain_margin 4, abstain_multi_person 1. Of the 33 no_candidate, 21 fail the minimum-length eligibility gate (<6 characters), 10 are length 6-9 at distance >1, 2 are length >=10 at distance >2. BUT THE PRIZE IS SMALL: only 28 of the 83 admitted rows are recoverable at all, capping a one-token replacement at 28 edits = 0.037 WER points inside this class.
experiments.decision: No arm was built and none is proposed on the strength of this. The two readings that survive: (1) any further per-column selection idea over these three systems is working against a floor - at least 27.7% of the largest remaining class cannot be fixed by choosing a different candidate, because the right word is not in the column; (2) for exp-2026-08-11-name-repair the constraint is application rather than lexicon coverage, and the largest single attrition reason is the candidate-eligibility minimum-length gate. That is a DIAGNOSTIC ATTRIBUTION, NOT A RECOMMENDATION: the gate exists to suppress false positives and any change to it needs its own benefit-and-harm replay. The 0.037-point cap applies to this funnel only and is not a ceiling on the name-repair arm, whose -0.083 was measured over all positions on top of the whole-window vote.
caveats: ERRATUM 2026-08-17 (exp-2026-08-17-confirmation-audit): 'the autoresearch confirmation partition was not read' is true only of the harness API, which this experiment never called. It is FALSE about the labels - load_substrate() has no city filter, so every count here spans all 247 windows / 10 cities including the four sealed confirmation cities and their 27,665 reference tokens. Any hypothesis selected by reading these numbers cannot afterwards claim a confirmatory CI on that partition. exp_majority_taxonomy.py:13 and the report's opening paragraph now carry the same correction.

EVERY NUMBER IS HINDSIGHT, computed with the reference text. None of it is an achievable gain and none may be quoted as one. Nothing here went through a promotion gate and the autoresearch confirmation partition was not read.
25.2% is a share of the 3,969-edit W-to-column-oracle GAP, not of WER. In WER terms the whole-class replay is 1.336 absolute points, 13.3% relative to W.
g_W = 0 means 'no gain given W's other choices', not 'impossible under any surrounding decisions' - the 719-column replay still saves 2 edits jointly.

The near-additivity of the class closures (standalone and leave-one-class-out marginals agree to within 0.03 percentage points) is measured on this substrate only and does not license adding them up in general.

The entity funnel's 99 rows were selected BECAUSE the target is in a frozen file, so 93/99 measures correct-city routing conditional on membership, not overall dictionary coverage. The term lists were mined from material overlapping this benchmark and are optimistic and leaky.

The funnel runs name_repair.select() on W's normalized lowercase token stream, so the capital-mid signal of has_signal() is structurally unavailable and seen_freq is empty, making abstain_common unreachable. Both make it OPTIMISTIC about firing. '16 of 36 fires overlap a recoverable row' is an overlap statistic; it was not verified that the fired candidate is the beneficial target.

Class labels are text heuristics: closed word lists, a phonemic key, a string-shape prefix test deliberately named surface_suffix_neighbor rather than same_lemma, and frozen term-file membership. No morphological analyser, no NER, no audio. No acoustic-confusion class is claimed from text alone.

Sixth pass over the same 247 windows; being descriptive does not remove adaptive-overfitting pressure across passes. Agreement-with-OpenCouncil, not fidelity-to-audio. Alignment-conditional throughout.

msa.py was deliberately NOT modified: fusion_lab hashes it into the alignment cache key, so an attribution helper added there silently invalidates the 9 MB cache for every other run. The attribution DP is a local copy in exp_majority_taxonomy.py pinned to msa.oracle_select by test_majority_taxonomy.py; the cache key remains align_65b1c4d64618a429.

Two Codex passes shaped this. Job 95b03e7c, BEFORE any number: replaced single-backtrace outcome labelling with optimal-support sets, added the ambiguous class, separated g_oracle from g_W, made the type flags cross-cutting instead of a first-match class, rejected 'count / reference tokens' as a WER share, and required the entity funnel to key on the target. experiments.title: A fusion substrate whose adapter row carries its own per-word confidence
experiments.question: Every confidence this project holds came from a different decoding pass than the text inside W, so none of it can be attached to the columns the arbiter asks about. Can we stop needing a join by decoding once and keeping text and probabilities together?

experiments.question: Arm P is the best decoding result but takes 16 FORCED (blind) cuts across 14 of the 39 frozen windows, where speech runs past the 29.5 s deadline and no VAD silence exists.
